headline: BI Shares Payment System Data for End-2026, Fraud Can Be Detected!
summary: Bank Indonesia has begun building infrastructure to exchange payment system transaction data, targeted for completion at the end of 2026. The aim is to help detect fraud.
why: Bank Indonesia is the central bank and regulator of the payment system, so its data rules shape compliance costs for banks and fintech firms.
original_headline: BI Bagi-Bagi Data Sistem Pembayaran Akhir 2026, Fraud Bisa Ketahuan!
